|game_text=At each system a player controls with a capital starship, non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles) deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. |errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The image here is the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-33E-Lets_Go_Left.png]]), which shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-letsgoleft-pre.gif]], numbered 01E) prints a third wording, “their non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles)”, which is neither this text nor the card-list text of [[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata)]]; it is not recorded as a version.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “At each system a player controls with a capital starship, non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles) deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles)” to “their non-[Presence] characters and vehicles”. The card list marks the entry “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”. PC-E1 text: “At each system a player controls with a capital starship, their non-[Presence] characters and vehicles deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).”<ref name="cl-1250_33-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
